"""One-off VC-01 collection and bounded historical-cost probe, outside the repo."""
import collections
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path('/workspace/scratch/4e5267fe5990/source-integrity-toolkit')
OUT = Path('/workspace/scratch/4e5267fe5990/vc01-evidence')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
MODE = sys.argv[1]
os.environ.update(SIT_PHASE_UNIT='P3-W15', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',
                  PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1', PIP_NO_INDEX='1')
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT), str(ROOT / 'src')]
os.chdir(ROOT)
counts = collections.Counter()
started = time.perf_counter()


def audit(event, args):
    if event != 'subprocess.Popen':
        return
    executable, argv, cwd, env = args
    program = Path(str(executable)).name
    if program in ('git', 'git.exe'):
        counts['git:' + str(argv[1] if len(argv) > 1 else '<empty>')] += 1
    elif program.startswith('python'):
        counts['child_python'] += 1
    else:
        counts['other_child'] += 1


sys.addaudithook(audit)
import pytest


class Capture:
    def __init__(self):
        self.items = []
        self.reports = []

    def pytest_collection_finish(self, session):
        for item in session.items:
            obj = item.obj
            code = getattr(obj, '__code__', None)
            self.items.append({'nodeid': item.nodeid,
                               'qualname': getattr(obj, '__qualname__', None),
                               'function_name': getattr(obj, '__name__', None),
                               'code_line': code.co_firstlineno if code else None,
                               'code_path': code.co_filename if code else None})

    def pytest_runtest_logreport(self, report):
        self.reports.append({'nodeid': report.nodeid, 'when': report.when,
                             'outcome': report.outcome, 'seconds': report.duration})


selected = [
    'tests/contract/test_phase2_transition.py::W07R01Tests::test_prior_phase2_transition_tests_keep_every_statement',
    'tests/contract/test_phase2_transition.py::W08R01Tests::test_literal_permission_deltas_preserve_every_other_byte',
    'tests/contract/test_phase2_transition.py::W09R01Tests::test_literal_deltas_validate_every_live_predecessor_byte',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_current_migration_sources_match_reviewed_bytes_and_remain_live',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_w04_r01_two_live_methods_preserve_all_original_assertions_and_bindings',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_w05_r01_only_three_old_transition_methods_have_authorized_adaptations',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_w06_r01_only_seven_old_transition_methods_change_and_every_other_source_node_is_exact',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_w06_r01_actual_boundary_remains_original_six_paths_and_complete_accepted_history',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_w15_r02_source_deltas_preserve_every_prior_node_and_identity',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_w15_r03_source_deltas_preserve_existing_nodes_and_bound_only_ci_budgets',
]
capture = Capture()
before = {p: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          for p in subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files'], text=True).splitlines()}
counts.clear()
if MODE == 'collect':
    args = ['tests', '--collect-only', '-q', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider']
elif MODE == 'measure':
    args = [*selected, '-q', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider',
            '--basetemp', str(OUT / 'pytest'), '--junitxml', str(OUT / 'measure-junit.xml')]
else:
    raise ValueError(MODE)
probe_start = time.perf_counter()
status = pytest.main(args, plugins=[capture])
elapsed = time.perf_counter() - probe_start
probe_counts = dict(sorted(counts.items()))
after = {p: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in before}
result = {'mode': MODE, 'exit_code': int(status), 'elapsed_seconds': elapsed,
          'platform': platform.platform(), 'python': sys.version,
          'tools': {p: importlib.metadata.version(p) for p in
                    ('pytest', 'setuptools', 'iniconfig', 'packaging', 'pluggy', 'Pygments')},
          'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
          'tree': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'], text=True).strip(),
          'unit': 'P3-W15', 'purpose': 'unchanged accepted baseline only; not VC authorization',
          'measurement_scope': 'direct child launches observed in the pytest process; excludes descendants',
          'subprocess_counts': probe_counts, 'items': capture.items, 'reports': capture.reports,
          'selected': selected if MODE == 'measure' else 'all tests',
          'tracked_before': before, 'tracked_after_unchanged': before == after,
          'new_ci_run': False, 'release_certification': False}
(OUT / (MODE + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print('VC01_PROBE', json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ('items','reports','tracked_before','selected')}))
raise SystemExit(status)
